question: Is an asset uploaded against a PRIVATE repository reachable anonymously once quoted in a PUBLIC issue?
note: ANSWER: YES. Corrects an earlier record in this file that concluded the opposite. The canonical github.com/user-attachments/assets/<uuid> URL answers 404 to an unauthenticated GET in every case tested, which is what the earlier, wrong conclusion was based on. That URL never serves bytes to anyone. At render time GitHub rewrites it into a SHORT-LIVED SIGNED URL on private-user-images.githubusercontent.com, scoped by the UPLOADER USER ID (not by repository), with X-Amz-Expires=300. Fetching that signed URL with no credentials at all returned 200 for an asset uploaded against the PRIVATE repo and quoted in a PUBLIC issue. CONSEQUENCE: exposure follows WHERE THE URL IS QUOTED, not which repository it was uploaded against. Anyone who can read the comment can fetch the bytes.
